zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.2 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: 更新
items: Update Control 的下载进度只显示整数百分比。
安装并重启不再拦截 Electron 的 quit，macOS 会在下载后把更新预取进 Squirrel，以便替换正在运行的应用。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.2 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Updates
items: The Update Control shows a truncated integer download percent.
Install and restart no longer cancels Electron quit; macOS prefetches the update into Squirrel after download so the running application can be replaced.
